title: Hello
description: Request body of 'engine/hello', the mandatory first operation on every pipe. Result is HelloResult. See spec.md §5.

protocol-versions.description: Protocol major versions the host can speak, in preference order.

PartyInfo.title: PartyInfo
PartyInfo.description: Identification for diagnostics only; protocol semantics never depend on it.

Capabilities.title: Capabilities
Capabilities.description: Member names are an open vocabulary; each value is an object whose shape is defined where the capability is defined ({} when presence alone is the signal). Unknown names are ignored. v1 defines: push-events, encoding.

EncodingCapability.title: EncodingCapability
EncodingCapability.description: Frame encoding negotiation (spec.md §3.4). The host sends 'accepts' in preference order; the engine answers with 'selected'. Absent on either side means json. The hello exchange itself is always JSON, and JSON is mandatory for both parties, so negotiation cannot fail.

accepts.description: Encodings the host accepts, most preferred first.

EncodingName.title: EncodingName
EncodingName.description: How a frame is written on the wire, as distinct from the document it encodes. Open vocabulary; v1 defines only 'json' (UTF-8, the mandatory baseline). A new encoding is an additive change (spec.md §11.2) and never bumps the protocol version.

protocol-version.description: The version the engine selected; all subsequent frames on this pipe are governed by it.
